description: Compute det(xI-A) coefficients using the division-free Samuelson–Berkowitz Toeplitz recursion over a caller-selected modular ring.

source.title: On computing the determinant in small parallel time using a small number of processors
source.author: Stuart J. Berkowitz

output.encoding: N+1 descending coefficients [1,c1,...,cN] of det(xI-A) modulo modulus, all residues in [0,modulus)

workspace.meaning: At most 49 normalized matrix entries and five 8-entry coefficient/vector arrays, plus scalar state and bounded language-container overhead; caller output is accounted separately.

contract.ring: All arithmetic is reduced modulo the supplied integer modulus; modulus need not be prime. No modular inverse or division is used.
contract.normalization: Each signed matrix entry is mapped to its least nonnegative residue before the recursion.
contract.partition: For each trailing principal block A=[[a,R],[S,M]], transform the descending coefficient vector of det(xI-M) by the lower-triangular Toeplitz matrix whose first column is [1,-a,-R*S,-R*M*S,...].
contract.coefficient_update: If child coefficients are q[j] and Toeplitz first-column values are t[k], parent coefficient p[i]=sum(j=0..i, t[i-j]*q[j]) modulo modulus.
contract.order: Start with the empty trailing block polynomial [1], then add rows and columns from the bottom-right toward the top-left. Emit coefficients in descending powers of x, monic term first.
contract.overflow_bound: Each modular product is at most (999999999)^2 < 10^18; each accumulation is reduced after every product. Matrix-vector and coefficient sums therefore stay within signed 64-bit arithmetic.
contract.complexity: O(N^4) modular operations for the bounded sequential Toeplitz recursion and O(N^2) workspace.
contract.error_precedence: Validate the complete input frame before checking output nullness/capacity. Malformed input returns -1; otherwise null or undersized output returns -2 without writes.

references.primary: primary_oracle.py: construct successive trailing-block coefficients with the Samuelson–Berkowitz lower-triangular Toeplitz recurrence.
references.independent: independent_oracle.py: expand det(xI-A) over every permutation and accumulate each polynomial term.
